dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-midline exhibit sharp pixel intensity gradients transitioning from dark charcoal exteriors to light grey interiors. Geometry includes a prominent elongated ellipse on the posterior dorsal and an irregular, large-diameter closed ring on the central dorsal with jagged perimeter edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of solid, high-intensity silver-grey pixel clusters located on the anterior-lateral region and lower flank; these clusters are frequently amorphous and lack a central dark core, appearing as concentrated, overlapping patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary central-dorsal annulus and the posterior-dorsal annulus form a horizontal vector; a third vertex formed by a prominent lateral-mid blob cluster creates an obtuse triangle with the longest side extending towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: The lateral mid-section features a complex, interlocking chain of partially merged ring structures, creating a fractal-like tessellated pattern distinct from the more isolated dorsal rings.
